jobs.title: Creative Strategist - Ukraine
jobs.description:
Job Overview

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist & Graphic Designer to lead creative communication and deliver high-quality visual assets for fast-paced advertising campaigns. The ideal candidate combines strong graphic design and motion skills with a strategic understanding of ad performance, creative angles, and CPG audiences. This role will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, manage multiple projects and timelines, and use performance insights to continuously improve creative strategy and execution.

Core Tasks:

Act as the point of contact for creative communication and work delivery (primarily via Slack)
Assist team in translating ad concepts into ad angles
Design static images and motion graphics to support various ad campaigns
Review ad performance reports and summarize into actionable recommendations
Flag roadblocks early and surface issues before they become delays
Work closely with other departments to consistently deliver high quality creative work on time
Track performance data, identify trends, and adjust strategy as needed

Must Haves:

3 - 5+ years experience in a client-facing creative strategist role
3 - 5+ years experience as a graphic designer (preferably in a fast-paced CPG setting)
Portfolio demonstrating a history of design work for US-based CPG brands
Intermediate-advanced graphic design skills using tools like Adobe Creative Suite
Extremely organized, dependable, and proactive in communication
Confident in managing timelines and juggling multiple projects and tasks at once
Excellent (C-level) English communication and project management skills
Ability to work full-time EST aligned

Nice to Haves:

Background working with oral care or similar products

Job Description

About the Job:

As an Associate Creative Director - Art, you'll lead innovative creative campaigns across multiple accounts and brands, fostering inspiration and overseeing art direction, visual translation, and execution. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will ensure creative integrity, strategic alignment, and exceptional craft. You'll supervise and develop art team members, drive client relationships, and contribute to new business growth. By combining artistic vision with strategic thinking, you'll deliver compelling, award-worthy solutions.

A Day In The Life

Lead creative ideation, partnering with accounts, senior management, and clients to develop brand personality, positioning, and briefs.
Drive executional craft, collaborating with production to deliver high-quality work on time and budget.
Foster cross-functional collaboration, communicating effectively across departments.
Manage client relationships, understanding brand vision and messaging.
Develop and advocate for marketing strategies, possessing in-depth brand knowledge.
Supervise and mentor team members.
Ensure team utilization and productivity, partnering with Creative Resourcing.
Contribute to new business growth through pitch concepting and execution.
Demonstrate leadership, empathy, and professionalism in communications.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Design or related field.
7+ years of experience in Visual Communications, Graphic Design or Art Direction.
Pharmaceutical/Healthcare advertising experience (preferred).
Digital portfolio showcasing creative ability.
Expertise in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator).
Ability to inspire team confidence and motivation towards common goals.
Ability to foster collaborative environment, creativity and bold ideas.
Excellent interpersonal skills, coaching and people management.
Strategic thinking, problem-solving and communication skills.
Financial management and resourcing acumen.

jobs.title: Droga5 Senior Art Director
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Droga5, part of Accenture Song, is a creative agency with offices in New York, London, Dublin,Tokyo and São Paulo. From integrated communications and experience innovation to business design, Droga5 exists to build and sustain the most influential brands of the 21st century through creativity. Droga5 was founded in 2006 and has been recognized as Agency of the Year more than 25 times and was named both Ad Age and Adweek’s Agency of the Decade (2010–2019). Visit Droga5.com or @droga5 on all social platforms to get to know us better.

Creative @ Droga5

Creatives join Droga5 to do the most influential work of their careers - work that moves people and creates a positive impact on society, from a deep laugh to a shift in cultural norms. We’re always ambitious, infiltrating culture and changing minds. Our work is set apart by its point of view, and we know we’re only as good as the last piece of work that went out the door.

We’re a generous department who help each other, learn from each other, and respect each other. We know we’re at our best when everyone here is supportive of one another. About the work and our people, we care more.

Job Summary

The Senior Art Director is a proven creative. They are expected to consistently and independently come up with a volume of great ideas that are on brief, and also possess the self-editing skills to start shaping amazing campaigns for our clients. The Senior Art Director gets a chance to cut their teeth as managers—helping lead creative teams and presenting to clients.

When it comes to craft, the Senior Creative is not only fluent as an Art Director, they also have a solid amount of production experience under their belt. They have a strong opinion on how they want their vision executed and are confident leading production partners.

Job Responsibilities

Lead and own work, and formulate and develop disruptive ideas with minimal oversight or creative direction

Establish client relationships, owning presentations and working directly with clients on productions

Concept and art direct, developing storyboards and comps without assistance from the Design team

Understand and appreciate the importance of strategy, and ensure that all ideas are on brief

Manage multiple clients and deliverables simultaneously

Handle all facets of production and post-production with minimal supervision

Work with all disciplines to deliver projects of creative excellence on time

Demonstrate strong presentation skills, both internally and with clients

Give and receive constructive feedback in a respectful manner

Show maturity in dealing with the ups and downs of the business, and finds creative opportunities on even the most challenging of clients.

Mentor and lead creative teams.

Basic Qualifications

Portfolio or samples of work demonstrating smart, brand-building ideas and executions

4+ years of Art Direction experience with an Ad Agency.

Preferred Qualifications

Multi-faceted in developing different types of creative media

Production experience and ability to handle different types of productions

Expert proficiency in Photoshop and InDesign

Ability to work independently

Collaborative and team oriented with proficiency working with members of all different departments, with minimal supervision

Excellent communication and presentation skills for effective communication to clients, internal team and management

jobs.title: Brand & Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are currently seeking a thoughtful and ideally experienced, community-driven “end-to-end” strategist to lead brand and creative strategies from concept through full campaign development. Specifically, the right candidate will be responsible for discovering insights, articulating ideas, building proposals, owning briefs, and planning, designing, creating, editing, and developing content for various forms of brand strategies based on our clients’ business objectives and campaign goals.

In addition, this position requires an exceptionally creative individual who thrives on innovation and enjoys producing original work. Moreover, the ideal candidate should have a strong passion for marketing, storytelling, and a proactive voice in the campaign creation process. Not only are strong communication skills in English essential, but the ability to craft clever and engaging content is also critical. Furthermore, the successful candidate will be expected to identify and generate story ideas on a wide range of topics, while transforming them into compelling narratives across multiple channels.

Roles And Responsabilities

Conducting extensive research to gain in-depth knowledge of customer personas and analyse consumer thoughts and trends.
Creating clear and compelling strategic creative concepts to align with brand objectives.
Identifying target audience profiles and developing creative content that resonates with the brand’s customer personas.
Devising brand and content strategies aimed at converting both new and existing customers into success stories.
Creating and executing integrated marketing campaigns and social media strategies to enhance brand presence.
Planning and developing the campaign’s editorial calendar, ensuring consistency across all delivery platforms.
Overseeing the writing style and ensuring that the tone, style, and voice of all content are aligned with the brand’s guidelines.
Posting content in accordance with the Content Calendar, responding to comments where appropriate to foster a positive community.
Tracking and conducting periodic brand and content audits, calculating content ROI to assess effectiveness.
Planning and executing marketing and social media strategies to drive traffic and engagement across social media platforms and the website.
Producing written, digital, and animated content for social media channels, primarily on Facebook and Instagram, but also including LinkedIn, Twitter, and TikTok.
Monitoring the ongoing digital presence and suggesting solutions to improve visibility and engagement.
Researching influencer marketing, sourcing talent, and managing collaborations and brand ambassador relationships.
Managing and maintaining websites, including the company website and e-shop.
Working on briefs and preparing presentations for marketing campaigns.
Creating monthly plans and producing competitor analysis reports to measure the success and performance of digital media campaigns.
Developing, managing, and daily monitoring of paid campaigns to ensure maximum reach and return on investment.
Ensuring that social media campaigns stay within budget and keeping budget records up to date.
Engaging with audiences and responding accordingly to build relationships and brand loyalty.
Staying up to date with emerging social media and digital trends to inform strategy.
Regularly monitoring competitor social media sites to identify opportunities and threats.
Performing ad-hoc marketing tasks and projects as assigned, contributing to overall team goals.
Assisting in photoshoots, brand activations, and the organisation of events and webinars to support marketing initiatives.

Minimum Skills, Knowledge And Experience

A Bachelor’s degree in Marketing Communications, Journalism, or a related field.
Ideally, a minimum of 2 years of professional experience in the industry.
The ability to write effectively, ensuring proper tone, structure, and emotion, with attention to grammar.
A high level of creativity, attention to detail, and strong organisational and project management skills are essential.
Strong research skills, coupled with the ability to think creatively and strategically.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to lead client meetings and/or present pitches confidently.
Expertise in creating content across various mediums, including social media, print, web, email, and video, ensuring each format is tailored to its audience.
The ability to write persuasively and, when necessary, defend proposed creative strategies with confidence and clarity.
A keen awareness of current trends, with the ability to create compelling, modern storytelling that resonates with the target audience.
The ability to manage time effectively, as some projects may take longer to complete and require quick turnaround times for revisions.

The vacancy is open for full time work, part-time work or on reduced hours.
